## Codex execution contract

**CGS-17 QA evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional and disclose when unavailable. A native delegate must actually run to be independent; otherwise use an explicitly labelled in-session fallback. Prior user authorization and host permissions govern all writes. Assess each story type against the resolved QA level and strictness. Logic waivers at minimal do not waive Visual/Feel or UI evidence: required retained screenshots and sign-off are not replaced by passing unit tests. Distinguish missing, incomplete, waived and NOT ASSESSED.
